world.forward_axis: +Z toward the camera; SpriteRenderer plane is XY

components.name: PlayerBrain
components.responsibility: Owns the hierarchical gameplay state machine and coordinates modules.

components.name: PlayerInputReader
components.responsibility: Converts Input System callbacks into buffered intent; contains no physics.

components.name: SpiderMotor2D
components.responsibility: Ground/air Rigidbody2D velocity, acceleration, jump buffer, coyote time, landing classification.

components.name: SwingController2D
components.responsibility: Anchor acquisition, DistanceJoint2D lifecycle, rope length, pump/reel forces, release momentum.

components.name: WebTargetResolver2D
components.responsibility: Scores visible WebAnchor2D candidates by aim alignment, height, distance, and obstruction.

components.name: WallTraversal2D
components.responsibility: Wall cling/crawl, ledge detection, climb arc, and wall jump handoff.

components.name: PlayerSensors2D
components.responsibility: Ground, wall, ceiling, ledge, hazard, and mapped-surface queries using non-allocating casts.

components.name: AnimationDriver2D
components.responsibility: Maps gameplay state to clips, sets SpriteRenderer.flipX, emits frame events only for presentation.

components.name: PlayerAudioView
components.responsibility: Subscribes to gameplay events and plays randomized one-shots without affecting state.

components.name: WebLineView2D
components.responsibility: Draws the line between wrist socket and anchor with a URP 2D unlit material.

components.name: ProjectionLayout
components.responsibility: ScriptableObject containing calibrated physical-surface geometry and output settings.

components.name: MappedSurface2D
components.responsibility: Marks an invisible Collider2D as ground, shelf, frame, wall, one-way platform, and/or web-attachable.

components.name: ProjectionCalibrationController
components.responsibility: Shows calibration grid, editable colliders/anchors, blackout, and persistence.

transition_rules: Any controllable state -> Hurt on damage unless invulnerable.
Any non-defeat state -> Defeat when health or fail condition reaches zero.
Grounded Idle/Run/Crouch -> JumpStart when buffered Jump is accepted.
JumpStart -> JumpRise immediately after applying jump impulse; do not wait for animation exit time.
JumpRise -> Apex when absolute vertical velocity enters the apex threshold.
Apex -> Fall when vertical velocity is negative beyond the apex threshold.
Airborne or Grounded -> WebShoot when Swing is performed and a candidate anchor exists.
WebShoot -> SwingAttach when the anchor ray reaches the target; SwingAttach -> SwingLoop when the joint is enabled.
SwingLoop -> SwingRelease when Swing is canceled, the anchor is invalid, or the rope is obstructed.
Airborne -> Land when a ground sensor hit occurs; use Fall impact speed to choose soft/hard landing.
Land -> Run when Move is held; Land -> Idle otherwise; hard landing may route to Roll when Roll is buffered.
Grounded moving -> Roll on Roll performed; Roll remains interruptible by Hurt and Swing.
Airborne -> WallCling when a valid wall contact exists, toward-wall input is held, and vertical speed is within limits.
WallCling -> WallCrawl with vertical input; WallCling/WallCrawl -> LedgeGrab when upper wall ray misses and ledge ray hits.
LedgeGrab -> LedgeClimb with toward/up input; all surface states -> Fall when contact is lost.
physics_notes: Use a Dynamic Rigidbody2D with Continuous collision detection and Interpolate.
Use a CapsuleCollider2D for the player; change its size for crouch/roll through state-owned profiles.
Enable one DistanceJoint2D only while swinging. Set autoConfigureDistance false and update distance for reel input.
Do not animate the player's root transform. Sprite animation is visual-only under a Rigidbody2D root.
Collider2D geometry is already invisible; a mesh does not need to be created and hidden.
